_about: Named texture patches of the Set1 vehicle atlases, read from where the original units map their faces (2026-10-28). rect = [u0, v0, u1, v1] in texture pixels (0..255). studio_swatches draws every patch from the user's own Set1 (no picture is shipped). Yellow/black key areas of the atlases are left out on purpose.
_donors_about: Original block (source model, block number) copied when a model has no opaque block with that texture: a texture name can only be renamed to one that is not longer, so copying is the safe route.

_expanded: Second pass 2026-11-24: patches of the same unit atlases that the first list skipped (read from the UV overlays in assets/atlas_uv). Triangle patches: map 3-corner faces only. Third pass 2026-11-25: every UV polygon of the 371 Set1 visual prototypes was drawn over its atlas and compared with these rectangles; what is left uncovered is sprite art on yellow key (gun silhouettes, lattices, rocket fins) and polygon edges. Building facade atlases (CITY1, HYPE, BERUD, MACHT, SHRTTWND) are not here: they belong to the set tools.
